methodology: One long enterprise handbook, evidence-unit qrels, two query phrasings per intent. The embedding model, dense threshold, lexical/dense weights and Top-K are controlled; only chunking changes.
metric_definition: Recall@K is macro-averaged evidence-unit recall: evidence units covered by the top-K chunks divided by all required evidence units for each query, then averaged across queries.
